latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of creator-burnout-recovery-coach.
- Provides structured coaching for content creators experiencing or recovering from burnout.
- Diagnoses burnout type and distinguishes from depression or similar issues.
- Builds a triage and recovery plan, including immediate stabilization and long-term restructuring.
- Audits money pressure and helps reshape content cadence and obligations.
- Does not offer clinical support for depression—refers out when necessary.
